name: Kill it with something aimed at what makes it a tumour
description: Attack glioblastoma through a target specific to it — a mutated antigen, an oncolytic virus, a checkpoint — rather than with untargeted cytotoxicity.

grade.note: This node is graded on failures, which is why measured is 'none'. The EGFRvIII vaccine rindopepimut failed a randomised phase 3 (Weller 2017); nivolumab failed against bevacizumab in recurrent disease (Reardon 2020). Neoadjuvant anti-PD-1 showed a survival signal with immune correlates in a small randomised study (Cloughesy 2019), and recombinant poliovirus produced a tail of long survivors without shifting the overall curve (Desjardins 2018). L5 records that this approach has been tested to phase 3 in humans; the blocked reason is that it did not work.
grade.drift: Long survivors in single-arm oncolytic trials are frequently presented as efficacy. A survival tail without a control arm is a selection observation.

wouldMove: A randomised trial of a targeted or immunotherapeutic agent with an overall survival benefit.
